_notes: Phase 1 units. survivor = worker (staffs buildings, builds, goes on scavenging runs). defender = trained at Barracks from an idle survivor (still counts toward housing). training: cost/time per defender at Barracks L1; Barracks trainTimeMultiplier (buildings.json) scales time. garrison: a defender placed in a tower counts as its worker and multiplies tower damage. patrol: a defender holding a spot fights with its own range/damage/fireRate. knockedOut: Phase 1 has no permanent unit death; a unit at 0 HP is out for knockedOutSeconds, then reappears at the HQ at full HP. duringHorde: survivor behavior while zombies are on the map.
